notes: SUB-STUDY OF A MASTER PROTOCOL. This document is an intervention-specific appendix (ISA) of master protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (with the DPNP disease-state addendum H0P-MC-CPMP(3)). PDF page 1 (cover sheet) does not name the master protocol; the first page that does is the title page, PDF page 2, verbatim: "Master Protocol Title: A Master Protocol for Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Phase 2 Clinical Trials of Multiple Interventions for the Treatment of Chronic Pain" and "Master Protocol Number: H0P-MC-CPMP". The SoA (PDF p10) says verbatim: "This SoA shows visits and procedures unique to the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-NP01 (NP01) for LY3016859. Please refer to master protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (CPMP) and the diabetic peripheral neuropathic pain (DPNP) disease-state addendum (DSA) H0P-MC-CPMP(3) SoAs for additional information." Deferrals to the master (nothing filled from the master): lab tests other than those unique to NP01 (p33: "The master protocol CPMP describes tests that may be performed at additional times noted in the SoA for this ISA.") — so the SoA activities Hematology, Urinalysis, Urine drug screen and Hemoglobin A1c, and the master's part of Chemistry, have no composition here; NRS, PGI, BPI and Rescue medication usage reporting ED handling per the CPMP SoA (p11-12 SoA notes); early discontinuation procedures per the CPMP protocol SoA (p20); objectives/endpoints (p8, p18), eligibility (p21), discontinuation (p26), study procedures (p27), statistics (p31-32) and immunogenicity sample retention (CPMP Appendix 1, Section 10.1.12, p30) defer to CPMP/CPMP(3). Instruments C-SSRS, Self-Harm Supplement Form, Self-Harm Follow-up Form, PGI and BPI are named only in the SoA and its abbreviation line; no type, rater, recall, mode or scoring is printed in this document. Weight, Adverse Events, Concomitant medication and Rescue medication usage reporting have no further description here. Cross-references: soa_cross_references is empty for this protocol, so cross_references is an empty list. Abbreviations: the document has no stand-alone abbreviation list; entries come from the abbreviation lines under the schema/SoA (p10, p13), the risk table (p16), objectives table (p18), intervention table (p23), the SoA note naming the master (p10) and the lab-tests tables (p33 ACR/PCR, p36 NMH/BAT/ADA). Token in an SoA activity name not defined by any abbreviation in the document: "A1c" (Hemoglobin A1c). "ED" (used in SoA notes) is not defined as an abbreviation; the SoA column heading is "Early Discontinuation". Conflicts: targeted physical examination body sites read "mouth" in the SoA note (p11) but "month" in Section 8.1.1 (p27) — both recorded in the evidence; components follow the SoA note. ADA is defined as "anti-drug antibody" (p13, p36) and "anti-drug antibodies" (p16). PGI's SoA name is "PGI" but its definition is "Patient Global Impression of Change". Urine pregnancy: Appendix 2 (p34) also requires a serum pregnancy test at the screening visit (not an NP01 SoA activity). Page images: p33 (Appendix 1 lab-tests table, text layer runs the three columns together) was read from the PDF page image: Chemistry = Cystatin-C; Urine Chemistries = Albumin, Creatinine, ACR, Protein, PCR; Other Tests = Immunogenicity, Epiregulin, LY3016859 concentration, Urine pregnancy — the image confirmed the column assignment. p36 (hypersensitivity table) and p1 were also viewed; no page lacks a text layer. Specimens for the hypersensitivity tests are mixed (serum for tryptase/BAT, urine for NMH), so the panel's specimen is null. Version (rule 11): the PDF holds a single version, amendment (a) of ISA H0P-MC-NP01 (approved 27-Mar-2020); the SoA (p11-13) is from that version. The Protocol Amendment Summary of Changes (p4-5) lists changes from the original protocol (30 January 2020), which is not in the PDF (e.g. vital-sign and targeted physical examination details, additional urine pregnancy collection, additional hemoglobin A1c collection time added to the SoA) — no separate entries were needed. Redactions: several CCI redaction boxes (e.g. p7, p13, p16, p20, p29, p30, p31-33) and Section 8.6 (title redacted). Updated 2026-11-07 to schema 1.1 (no re-extraction): instruments carry kind.
